content.text:
Done. All changes are confined to src/payments/webhook.ts:

- Added 'replayed_signature' to VerifyFailureReason.
- createWebhookVerifier now keeps a per-verifier Map of accepted v1 digests -> signed timestamp; a second verify() with the same digest returns { ok: false, reason: 'replayed_signature' }.
- The check runs only after the HMAC comparison passes, so forged signatures are never cached, and entries older than toleranceSec are pruned on each call to bound memory.

Verification: npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; npm test reports 9 passed (9), including the previously failing replay case. src/legacy/adapter.ts was not opened or modified.

One caveat: the cache is in-process only, so a replay hitting a different instance or arriving after a restart within the tolerance window would still be accepted. A shared store would be needed to close that gap.
